fields.value: Cloud App (fdba33) Phase 1: work-planning hub, direct SDK push, and playable blobs / blind A/B UI

Filed from f4109f exploration (scratch/roadmap.md, Part I / Work-Planning Cloud App).

## Outcome

Evolve the push-fed Postgres `etude view --push` app (`fdba33`, PR #140) from a passive run viewer into Etude's work-planning hub and auto-research control tower, while enabling rich non-scalar evals (RL replays and real-time music AI):

1. **Work-planning & agent control tower:**
   - Group runs into living research plans/hypotheses with coverage gaps, active/queued attempts, spot-recovery timelines, and standing allowance / spend status (`EXP-61`) visible at a glance.
   - Support org-internal cross-experiment leaderboards/leagues in Postgres (joining pushed paired-seed eval Parquet blocks across experiments inside one organization, e.g., Manabot's league).
2. **Optional non-blocking direct SDK push:**
   - Allow local `etude train` / `etude eval`, Colab notebooks, and imperative Python `Experiment`/`Arena` calls to push observations & metric blocks to `fdba33` over HTTP (today only `launch/worker/attempts.py` pushes), keeping push strictly opt-in, best-effort, and isolated so outages never affect local/offline runs.
3. **Generic playable `blobs` + blind paired A/B rating UI:**
   - Render typed `Result.blobs` (audio `.wav`/`.mp3`, MIDI/piano-roll, game replays, images) inline beside metric tables in `fdba33` / `etude report` with bounded size caps.
   - Support blind paired A/B human evaluation over paired `match.seed` blobs, recording preference votes back into DuckDB/Postgres `Tables` for paired bootstrap CIs and Elo curves (directly serving both real-time music AI and qualitative RL/agent review).

## Notes & coordination

- Stacks on `fdba33` (PR #140). Canonical weights and full artifacts stay in the user's bucket; Postgres remains the fast index and work-planning layer.
